name: Crossblooded Disciple
body:
Your heritages develop almost at the same pace.

Prerequisite(s): Crossblooded sorcerer or crossblooded rager archetype, bloodline disciple level 1.

Benefit(s): Choose one bloodline you possess that doesn’t advance its powers with your bloodline disciple levels (it can’t be one you gained through Eldritch Heritage). Your bloodline disciple levels stack with your sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from this bloodline. You still can’t gain new powers through level increase from a bloodline you didn’t select for your bloodline disciple subclass.
